verification.retained_failed_attempt: The first 176-test run had one import-boundary failure because math and email were not declared. Exact ownership for those standard-library utilities was added only for https_transport.py; the complete 176-test rerun passed.
verification.negative_control: Restoring the original inline-retry behavior reproduces PauseExceedsBound and loses the 48-hour provider cooldown before managed state can preserve it.

scope: Bounded source reads and offline reliability checks. Registry configuration is not an installed schedule, a maintained public feed or publication approval.

reproduced_failure.second_failure: The transport's inline pause raises PauseExceedsBound with the watch's zero-pause budget before the response delay reaches managed source state.

decision: Keep the existing transport, request accounting, source edge and managed state. Let the watch disable inline rate-limit retry and persist the source cooldown. Never use forced cadence to bypass that minimum. Preserve last successful observations and validators.

references.finding: Retry-After accepts nonnegative integer delay-seconds or HTTP-date. The delay begins after the response is received.
429 denotes rate limiting and can provide Retry-After. Rate accounting can cover a resource, server or group; this URL-bound watch state is not a replacement for account-wide quota accounting.
Reviewed its explicit retry policy and Retry-After support. Did not replace the existing transport or adopt a retry-delay cap that could schedule before a longer source-requested delay.
The website repository labels its code MIT. This check does not establish rights for all article text, third-party art or media; no such content is republished.

Content access and reuse remain subject to the source terms and any accompanying licence. The selected feed is a publisher-hosted aggregate that includes community authors; it is not uniform official advice or a blanket redistribution licence.

limits: Only the declared latest feed windows were inspected. Source publication dates, HTTP observation dates and current customer applicability are different.

Hugging Face returned 876 entries but only the first 40 were considered. A one-off conditional 304 proves server validator handling, not complete parsing or prospective freshness. The watch does not retain a conditional validator after such a partial parse.
Godot's latest retained publication was September 29 and Hugging Face's was October 3. Neither date is relabeled as fresh October 13 news.

The watch has twelve configured feeds after the addition and retains its twelve-request tick ceiling. This does not increase the sixty-source public AgentFeeds directory or establish twelve scheduled collectors.
Blender development-blog discovery returned an access refusal in the research tool; no workaround, adapter activation or source addition was attempted.

consumer_use.value: Avoid hammering a throttled source, keep the last successful evidence honest, and give agents direct release and model/tool research leads.
needed_information: Pinned project/tool/model versions and target environment
Original source reference and publication date
Current coverage, last success and provider cooldown
Source-specific access/reuse rights and explicit effect limits
consumer_use.next_action: Use a discovered Godot release or model-method post as a bounded verification question. Check primary changes and run an authorized environment-specific test before recommending adoption.
consumer_use.runtime_and_records: Existing canonical source-read Loop, CommunityStore records, reactive work orders and local watch command. No new scheduler, queue, model engine, file format or public endpoint.
consumer_use.recovery: Inspect the existing --list source mode without network. Wait for finite cooldown expiry. An unrepresentable delay requires verified provider/time evidence and an authorized managed-record correction; force does not clear it.
consumer_use.improvement_path: Qualify a pinned scheduled pilot and trace its actual observations into independently reviewed decision material. Add coverage only for missed useful questions; do not equate a source entry with accepted customer work.
